capabilities: browse images and videos embedded in the active note in a searchable sidebar
filter media by type and search filenames and section headings
view media in a full-window viewer with zoom, swipe and keyboard navigation
inspect file information such as size, dimensions and video duration
return to the original embed or share and copy the media file
disambiguation: It only shows media embedded in the currently active note, not a gallery of the whole vault or remote URLs.
extras: The manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. The README states there are no network requests, telemetry, accounts or writes to notes, and playback depends on codecs supported by Obsidian on each device. Release and installation sections are developer-facing; manual installation is described.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to see and navigate all media embedded in a note at a glance; you must scroll through the note or browse folders manually.
summary: Sidebar gallery that browses images and videos embedded in the active note, grouped by section, with a full-window zoom viewer.
